status: Private proposed protocol only; stopped live session is not resumed.
scope: Synthetic one-byte attention packets; not full move concealment.

payload.prior_for_blind_test: Independent uniform byte 0..255, frozen before encoding each card.

keys.generation: OS CSPRNG via secrets.token_hex(32); new key and random 16-byte session ID per experiment.
keys.warning: Synthetic key is solely for reproducible vectors and gives no secrecy.

metadata.session_id: 32 lowercase hex characters; selected out of band, not in carrier
metadata.record_id: ASCII regex [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}; unique per session; expected out of band
metadata.context_sha256: 64 lowercase hex; SHA256 of agreed immutable ASCII context bytes, expected out of band. Synthetic context bytes: post-stop-neutral-fixture-no-gameplay.

frame.serialization: For each field, append unsigned 4-byte big-endian ASCII byte length followed by exact ASCII bytes. Concatenate in listed order; no separators or normalization.

carrier_grammar: 20..180 maximal [A-Za-z]+ word runs; 1..1600 bytes; printable ASCII 0x20..0x7E only; no leading/trailing spaces or consecutive spaces. Reject all other whitespace/nonASCII. No silent repairs.
decode: Validate expected metadata and grammar. HMAC-SHA256 exact frame. VALID iff digest[1]==167 (0xA7). Payload is unsigned digest[0]. Map upper two bits to lens and lower six to square. Otherwise INVALID/ABSTAIN; never infer from meaning.
encode: Choose truthful private payload before encoding; freeze a coherent, truthful, natural candidate pool and ordering independently of payload. For each distinct candidate, validate grammar, compute framed HMAC, retain first digest[0]==payload and digest[1]==167. Stop after at most 2^20 candidates; FAIL/ABSTAIN if none. Never change target to fit a carrier. Recompute final exact text independently and semantically review before publication.

slots: without claiming more than the evidence supports
synthetic_pool.meaning: General analysis-method prose only; no live-position analysis or move recommendation.

duplicate_handling: Receiver binds expected session, record and context. Exact accepted retransmission is idempotent; do not apply twice. A second distinct VALID carrier for the same record yields CONFLICT/ABSTAIN and quarantines the record. Invalid variants do not consume a record. Reject unknown/replayed records. Corrections require a fresh explicitly authorized record ID, never silent replacement.
invalid_behavior: Report metadata/grammar/filter failure or CONFLICT/ABSTAIN; no semantic fallback; no state advance on invalid. Missing carrier is erasure. Transport alteration is not repaired.
limits: The eligibility byte accepts about 1/256 random altered messages; it is not authentication.
Expected encoding work is 65536 candidates; failure remains possible within the finite pool.
Key-dependent decoding does not hide semantic clues, action choices, timing, length, templates, candidate-pool bias, or model-context leakage.
Naturalness and semantic relevance need fresh contextual review; generic synthetic prose is not evidence of natural live discussion.
blind_private_ground_truth: semantic_ground_truth_private.json; never include with cards or expose key to a guesser.

semantic_test_plan.internal: Black A freezes exact byte/square/lens guesses and confidence from cards alone before opening private target/key files; construction-aware results only.
semantic_test_plan.fresh_opponents: Host supplies cards and uniform priors only to fresh key-unaware opponents in isolated contexts; no protocol/source/targets/key; record exact packet, square, lens, semantic rationale, abstention and confidence.
semantic_test_plan.baselines: Exact-byte chance 1/256; square 1/64; lens 1/4 under matched uniform priors. Compare against identical covers with shuffled labels and no-carrier prior baseline.
semantic_test_plan.controls: Evaluate exact unchanged teammate decode, harmless-looking text mutations, wrong context/record/key, replay/conflict, varied cover families, and target-semantic correlation separately.
semantic_test_plan.full_move: Not measured or encoded by this toy schema. Any future action/move recovery test needs a separately specified payload and preregistered matched action priors.

claims: Standard HMAC and rejection sampling are canonical components. No global novelty claim, no overall cryptographic-security claim, and no empirical concealment claim from these fixtures.
encoder_bounds: Validate key, metadata, integer payload 0..255 and integer budget 0..2^20 before search. Each yielded candidate consumes one attempt, including duplicates and grammar failures; skip these and continue. Exhaustion or budget end returns ENCODER_FAILURE with attempts. No unbounded resampling.
receiver_api: Receiver(key, expected_session, expected_record, expected_context) validates and binds trusted metadata. receive(supplied_session, supplied_record, supplied_context, exact_carrier) first rejects mismatch, then enforces decode and idempotent duplicate/conflict rules. Low-level decode is not a receiver trust boundary.
